clientTriggerId.description: Client-provided trigger ID for idempotency, unique per sub-account, pair and trigger type. While the trigger is active and for 60 seconds after it reaches a terminal status, retrying the create with the identical intent returns the same trigger, and a different intent with the same ID returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID. After those 60 seconds the ID is free: a create that uses it is a new intent and creates a new trigger. To learn the outcome of an earlier create after that window, read the triggers with ListTriggers, which return each trigger's client_trigger_id, instead of retrying the create. After a create fails with INTERNAL_ERROR, the ID may already be used: a retry then returns CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID and needs a new client trigger ID. At most 36 bytes in UTF-8 (36 ASCII characters); longer IDs are rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

version.description: Per-trigger state version: 1 for the trigger's first state, then higher for every later published state change, whether a request or the market caused it. A higher version is always newer, and two copies of a trigger with the same version show the same state. GetTrigger, ListTriggers and realtime trigger updates carry the same version for the same state. List results can briefly lag realtime updates, and after a reconnect or a service recovery a realtime update can repeat an earlier state, so keep the copy of each trigger with the highest version and ignore any copy whose version is not higher than the one you hold.

A rise that fires above it still fires, and the child fills only at or below it. Must be unset when `side` is SELL. Fixed at create.

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Values below 10000 are accepted; a 100% cap would leave a trailing stop that sells no positive price to sell at.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Positive maximum absolute price delta in Q9 execution-price ticks (1 tick = 1e-9 quote units).

trailingDistance.description: Trailing distance as a decimal price delta in quote asset units, for example '0.5'.

triggerPriceSource.description: Price the trailing stop watches: its activation, its peak or trough and its fire all follow this price. Unspecified or LAST_PRICE watches the last traded price. INDEX_PRICE watches the market's index price; a market without an index price fails the trigger with INDEX_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE. MARK_PRICE is not supported. Fixed at create: to change it, cancel the trigger and create a new one.

version.description: Per-trigger state version: 1 for the trigger's first state, then higher for every later published state change, whether a request or the market caused it. A higher version is always newer, and two copies of a trigger with the same version show the same state. GetTrigger, ListTriggers and realtime trigger updates carry the same version for the same state. List results can briefly lag realtime updates, and after a reconnect or a service recovery a realtime update can repeat an earlier state, so keep the copy of each trigger with the highest version and ignore any copy whose version is not higher than the one you hold.

activationPrice.description: Updated activation price as a decimal string in quote asset units per base asset unit, for example '62000'. Set to '0' to clear an existing activation price; omit to leave it unchanged.

limitPrice.description: Not modifiable: a trigger's child limit price is fixed at create. Setting this field rejects the whole request with TRIGGER_CHILD_PRICE_NOT_MODIFIABLE (InvalidArgument, HTTP 400) and leaves the trigger unchanged; cancel the trigger and create a new one to change the child limit price.

maxSlippageBps.description: Updated maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Set to zero to clear the cap. A buy stop-loss or take-profit with a market child accepts 1 to 10000, as at creation. A trailing stop on either side, and a sell stop-loss or take-profit, accept 1 to 9999: 10000 is rejected with MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID, because a 100% cap would leave a sell no positive price, and a trailing stop takes none on either side.

maxSlippageTicks.description: Non-negative maximum absolute price delta in Q9 execution-price ticks (1 tick = 1e-9 quote units). Set to zero to clear the cap.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ORDERS_SUSPENDED: New orders, changes and trigger orders on this account are suspended until a balance issue is resolved; cancels still work. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_REPAIRING: This account's orders are being canceled while its balances are brought back in line, so new orders, changes and trigger orders are paused for a short time. Nothing changed; cancels still work. Try again shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_RESERVATION_LIMIT_REACHED: The account's open orders and triggers hold its maximum number of fund reservations.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_ROUTING_INVALID: The account's trading route is not configured for triggers, so the trigger was not admitted. Contact support if it persists.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: Referenced account could not be resolved by the trading service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_MARKET_DENY: API key policy does not allow trading this market, even though the sub-account policy does.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED: The API key has no policy, so it has no permissions: attach a policy to the API key that grants what it needs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_ROOT_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to the master/root account and cannot trade on sub-accounts.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SPOT_READ_DENY: API key policy does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: The API key's policy does not allow spot trading: enable TRADE_SPOT (Spot Trading Write) on the API key's policy. When both the key's and the sub-account's policies lack it, the key is named first.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUBACCOUNT_MISMATCH: API key is scoped to a different sub-account than the one requested.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_SUB_SCOPE_ONLY: API key is scoped to a specific sub-account and cannot trade on the master/root account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.API_KEY_UNKNOWN: API key referenced in the request could not be resolved by the Orders service.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_EXIT_WORKING: An exit order placed by one of the order's attached take-profit or stop legs is still working, so the order's attached legs can't be added, edited, paused or resumed now; removing a leg is still accepted. Nothing changed; retry once the exit completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_LEGS_EXCEEDED: The order already carries every attached leg it may hold, so another attached leg was refused. Legs being cancelled count until they end: retry once they have ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ATTACHED_RISK_NOT_SUPPORTED: Attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing legs can't be applied here: this market takes none, an attached trailing stop isn't offered yet, the modify changes them together with the order's price, quantity, client order ID or a replace, or the order was placed by a triggered take-profit, stop-loss or trailing-stop leg, which can't carry legs of its own. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_PRICE: Price is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_QTY: Quantity is invalid for the requested order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BAD_REQUEST: Request could not be parsed or was structurally invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_OTHER_ITEM_INVALID: Another item of the same batch was invalid, so this item was not applied either. Nothing in the batch changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_REPLACE_ONLY_REQUIRED: No longer returned: each BatchReplaceOrders item follows ModifyOrder's default amend-or-replace rule. The value stays reserved.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_SINGLE_SYMBOL_REQUIRED: An item of the batch modify named no symbol, or another symbol than the batch's first item, so the batch was refused.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_TOO_LARGE: Batch size exceeds the maximum allowed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_SCOPE_CONFLICT: A cancel-all-after is already due to fire, and the re-arm's scope does not cover every symbol of the pending one.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_TIMEOUT_INVALID: The cancel-all-after timeout is neither 0, which disarms it, nor between 10 and 120 seconds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_REQUEST_EXPIRED: The cancel request exceeded its bounded internal replay window.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCEL_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE: The cancel-all request named more than 100 symbols.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_ORDER_INCONSISTENT: The trigger's child order did not match the order the trigger requested, so the trigger failed and the child order was canceled.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: The new quantity of a TWAP order's slice would leave more than the TWAP's remaining quantity. Nothing changed; a slice can be raised up to what the TWAP still has to execute.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CHILD_QTY_RAISE_NOT_ALLOWED: The quantity of a trigger's child order or a ladder order can't be raised above its planned quantity. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_IDS_EXHAUSTED: The account reserves its maximum number of client order IDs, including those of recently ended orders. Retry once they expire, or send the request without a client order ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_ORDER_ID_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue's capacity for reserved client order IDs is exhausted right now, so the trigger's child order could not reserve one. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID_INVALID: The client trigger ID is empty, longer than 36 bytes or otherwise not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_FLAGS_INVALID: The trigger's condition flags were not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONDITION_PARAMETER_SET: The trigger set a condition parameter its condition does not take.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: Client order ID is already in use on this account, by an open order or by an order that ended recently; an ended order keeps its client order ID reserved for at least 60 seconds. Reuse returns this code even with the same payload. Use GetOrder to reconcile, then retry with a new client order ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID: Client trigger ID is already used, either by a trigger with a different payload or by an earlier create that failed or was rolled back. List triggers to reconcile by client trigger ID, then retry with a new client trigger ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DRY_RUN_INVALID: The cancel-all request's dry-run flag was neither 0 nor 1.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID: The order identifier assigned to the request is already in use by another order of the market. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.EMPTY_BOOK: Market order could not execute due to empty book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_INVALID: The trigger's fee asset was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ASSET_NOT_ALLOWED: Requested fee asset is not allowed for this order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_CEILING_INVALID: The trigger's maximum fee rate was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE: The fees that apply to the order cannot be determined right now, so it was not admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: FOK order rejected due to insufficient immediate liquidity.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.GATEWAY_MISCONFIGURED: The trading gateway that took the request is misconfigured for the order service behind it. An operator must correct it; retrying does not help.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ICEBERG_DISPLAY_INVALID: The iceberg display quantity is not below the order's quantity, or is not a multiple of the pair's quantity step. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ICEBERG_DISPLAY_TOO_SMALL: The iceberg display quantity is below the pair's minimum order quantity, or splits the order's quantity into more than 100 parts: it must be at least the order's quantity divided by 100, rounded up. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ICEBERG_NOT_ALLOWED: A display quantity was set on an order that cannot be an iceberg order. Only good-till-cancelled and good-till-date limit orders without attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop orders can be iceberg orders. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Account does not have enough available balance for the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTENT_ID_INVALID: The cancel-all or cancel-all-after request carried an intent identifier of zero.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: Order processing failed because of an unexpected error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_CLIENT_ORDER_ID: The client order ID is longer than 36 bytes or otherwise not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_HANDLING_MODE: The order handling mode is not a known or accepted mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_MODIFY_BEHAVIOR: The modify behavior is not a known behavior.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_FLAGS: An order flag is unknown, or not accepted with this order type or time in force, or on a trigger's child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_ID: The order identifier or the replacement order identifier is not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_ORDER_TYPE: The order type, or a trigger's child order type, is not a known order type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_PEG: Entry peg has an invalid reference or unsupported combination.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SIDE: The order side, or a trigger's child order side, is not a known side.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_STP_MODE: The self-trade prevention mode is not a known mode.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TIME_IN_FORCE: The time in force, or its expiry time, is not accepted for this order or for a trigger's child order type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TRIGGER_CONTROL: The requested trigger operation is not a known operation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_TRIGGER_TYPE: The trigger type is not a known type.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVELS_INVALID: A ladder places from 2 to 100 orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_LEVEL_REJECTED: One of the ladder's orders can't be placed, so the ladder was not created. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER_RANGE_TOO_NARROW: The ladder's price range is too narrow to place its orders at least one price tick apart.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.LIMIT_CHILD_SLIPPAGE_SET: The TWAP sets a slippage bound, but its slices are LIMIT orders, which take none.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_LADDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account already has the most ladder orders one account may have on this market. Nothing changed; retry once one of them ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: MARKET BUY cannot be reserved because no reference/top-of-book price is available.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_QUOTE_STALE: The market order carried no client reference price, and the pair's reference quote (top of book) was older than its freshness bound when the order was admitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_QUOTE_UNHEALTHY: The market order carried no client reference price, and the pair's reference quote could not be used to price it, for example because it postdated the order or carried an invalid price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_TRIGGER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account already has the most triggers one account may have on this market, attached take-profit, stop-loss and trailing legs included. Nothing changed; retry once one of them ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MARKET_TWAP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The account already has the most TWAP orders one account may have on this market. Nothing changed; retry once one of them ends.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_NOTIONAL: Order notional is above the pair maximum (quote units). A stricter sub-account policy cap returns POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_PER_PAIR: The account has reached its maximum number of resting orders in this market. Good-till-cancelled and good-till-date orders count until they end; immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill and market orders never count, and a replace keeps its order's place. Nothing changed; cancel a resting order in this market first.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_OPEN_ORDERS_TOTAL: The account has reached its maximum number of open orders across all markets. A stricter sub-account policy cap returns POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_QTY: Quantity is above the pair maximum: the market-order maximum for MARKET orders, the limit-order maximum otherwise (base units).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID: Max slippage (ticks or bps) is out of range or leaves no valid execution price bound. Applies to market orders and to standalone and attached trailing stops, on create and on modify; for example, a 10000 bps cap on a market order or trailing stop that sells.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_NOTIONAL: Order notional is below the pair minimum.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MIN_QTY: Quantity is below the pair minimum quantity (base units).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE: Modify request in AMEND_ONLY mode requires replace semantics.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NEW_ACCOUNT_CAPACITY_REACHED: The venue holds its maximum number of account access records, so an account trading this market for the first time cannot be admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_FOUND: Requested order or resource was not found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL: The order has already ended (filled, canceled or expired).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CANCEL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The order cancellation was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may still apply; read the order before retrying. For a batch cancellation, every item's outcome is unknown; read them back. For a cancel all, some or all of the matching orders may be canceled; read open orders. For a cancel all after heartbeat, the switch may or may not have been armed, refreshed or disabled; send the heartbeat again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_CREATE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The order was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may have been accepted; read the order by its client order ID, or read open orders, before retrying. For a batch create, every item's outcome is unknown; read them back, or repeat the batch with the same request ID and payload within 15 minutes, which returns decided items' original results and retries the rest without admitting any item twice.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_ID_CONFLICT: The order identifier is held by a different, earlier order, so the request was not applied. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: This market's order limits aren't set yet, so it can't take new orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_MODIFY_IN_PROGRESS: An earlier amend or replace of the order has not completed yet. A batch replace answer means its items were admitted, not completed, so the next refresh of the same order can get this code. Retry after a short backoff. For a batch item, resend only that item in a new batch under a fresh request ID, because the rejected batch's request ID returns this rejection again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_MODIFY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The order modification was sent but not confirmed in time. Its outcome is unknown and it may still apply; read the order before retrying. For a batch replacement, every item's outcome is unknown; read them back.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_PLACEMENT_PENDING: The placement of the order, or of the replacement an earlier replace created, has not been confirmed yet, so it cannot be modified. It may already rest on the book. A refresh that names the replacement order ID from a batch whose replace has not been confirmed yet gets this code. Retry after a short backoff, as for ORDER_MODIFY_IN_PROGRESS.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_REPAIRING: This order is being canceled while the account's balances are brought back in line, so it can't be changed. Nothing changed; cancels still work, and the account's other orders can still be changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: The account used every order identifier available to it in this market. Retrying does not help; contact support.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_AUCTION: This market is in an auction call and takes only limit orders that rest without crossing the book; market, immediate-or-cancel and fill-or-kill orders are refused. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ORDER_UNKNOWN: Referenced order could not be resolved.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.OVERLOADED: The account already has its maximum order requests in flight; nothing was admitted. ConnectRPC returns RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (HTTP 429); REST returns HTTP 503. No Retry-After or RateLimit-* headers are supplied. Retry after one of the outstanding requests completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_BACKLOGGED: The trading pair is busy with the account's earlier requests, so this one was not admitted and nothing was reserved. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DELISTED: Pair was delisted and is no longer tradable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DISABLED: Pair is disabled and does not accept orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_NOT_LISTED_YET: Pair exists but is not listed yet.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_POST_ONLY: Pair is in post-only mode and requires post_only=true.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_REDUCE_ONLY: Pair is in reduce-only mode and does not accept new spot orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PATH_BODY_ID_MISMATCH: A non-empty resource ID in the REST request body differs from the path ID. Nothing changed. Use the same ID in both places, or omit the body ID.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PEG_LIMIT_VIOLATION: Resolved peg exceeds its buy cap or falls below its sell floor.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PEG_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Selected entry-peg book side has no live quote.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller is authenticated but not allowed to perform this action.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MARKET_DENY: Sub-account policy prevented trading on this market (e.g. pair mask).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL: Sub-account policy max order notional exceeded.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_MAX_OPEN_ORDERS: Sub-account policy maximum number of open orders has been reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_READ_DENY: Sub-account policy does not allow reading spot data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY: The sub-account's policy does not allow spot trading: enable TRADE_SPOT (Spot Trading Write) on the sub-account's policy. A sub-account without a policy is read-only. When the API key's policy lacks it instead, the refusal is API_KEY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_TRADING_HALTED: Trading has been globally halted for this sub-account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The account's trading policy cannot be evaluated right now, so the order was not admitted. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_CROSS: Post-only order would cross the book.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_LIMIT_ONLY: Post-only is only valid for LIMIT orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POST_ONLY_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_AUCTION: This market is in an auction call; new post-only orders are refused. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION: Price band guard rejected the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_LEVELS_EXHAUSTED: The order book of the market holds its maximum number of distinct price levels, so an order at a new price cannot rest. Nothing changed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_LEVEL_QUANTITY_LIMIT: The order would take the total quantity resting at its price past the most a price level can hold, even if some quantity still fits. Nothing changed: a new order was not placed, a modified order keeps resting as it was, and the other orders at that price are unchanged. Another price or a smaller quantity, or the same order once less quantity rests at that price, is accepted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRICE_TICK_SIZE: Price must align with the pair tick size, including trigger and activation prices.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_AT_OR_BELOW_FILLED: The replacement total quantity is at or below the order's filled quantity: the order ended at its filled quantity and no replacement order was created.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QTY_STEP_SIZE: Quantity does not align with the pair step size.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_ACCOUNT_OWNER_UNKNOWN: The QuickSwap account is not ready yet; no order was placed. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_ATTACHED_RISK_NOT_ALLOWED: QuickSwap orders can't carry take-profit or stop-loss legs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: The broker's fee account isn't available yet; retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE_TERMS_INVALID: The broker fee terms are invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE_TERMS_MISMATCH: The broker fee terms belong to another broker.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_FEE_TERMS_UNAVAILABLE: The broker fee terms aren't available yet; retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_BROKER_INVALID: The broker's QuickSwap setup is invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_CAPACITY_REACHED: QuickSwap's capacity for fee settings is reached; this order can't be placed.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_DISABLED: QuickSwap isn't enabled for this account's trading.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_DETAILS_INCOMPLETE: The request's QuickSwap fee details are incomplete: a fee schedule needs a broker, and a broker or broker fee terms need a fee schedule.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_RECIPIENT_IS_PAYER: A QuickSwap fee would be paid into the account placing the order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_SCHEDULE_INVALID: The QuickSwap fee schedule is invalid and can't be used.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_FEE_TOTAL_TOO_HIGH: The QuickSwap fees together would exceed the order's value.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.QUICKSWAP_SETUP_INVALID: QuickSwap's setup is invalid, so QuickSwap orders can't be placed.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_WOULD_TRIGGER_IMMEDIATELY: The change would act on the trigger at once. The new trigger price of a stop-loss or take-profit, or the trigger price a new trailing distance gives an activated trailing stop, is already reached by the price the trigger watches (at or past it), so the trigger would fire at once and send its order; or the new activation price of a trailing stop not yet activated is already reached by that price, so it would activate at once. Nothing changed; the trigger keeps its previous settings. Returned by ModifyTrigger, and by an order modify that moves an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop of an order with a fill. Also returned when a market order is created or previewed with an attached take-profit or stop-loss on the last price that its own fill would trigger, at or past the best price the order takes (the best ask for a buy, the best bid for a sell); the order is not placed. A market order with an attached take-profit or stop-loss on the index price that the index has already reached is accepted, then rejected with this reason before it trades, and so is one whose last-price leg the market reaches before the order reaches the book; nothing is placed. Choose a price the market has not reached.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.DECREMENT: Reduce both orders by the quantity that would have traded, with no trade. The order left with no quantity is canceled with STP_DECREMENT, both when their quantities are equal; a resting order that keeps a quantity keeps its place in the queue, and an incoming order that keeps one goes on matching and may rest. A reduced order's quantity is its original quantity less what self-trade prevention removed. A fill-or-kill order that would meet such an order before it is completely filled is rejected instead of reduced. Applies to attached protective exits and trigger children too. Prevention does not count as a fill of the parent position. A fully prevented attached exit re-arms its unexecuted exposure and waits while the surviving self maker heads the opposite book; it can fire again once that maker stops leading.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_LADDER: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the ladder and canceled its resting levels, releasing their reserved funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAIR_DRAIN_TRIGGER: The market was disabled: the exchange ended the stop-loss, take-profit or trailing stop and released its reserved funds. The market's open orders were canceled at the same time.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.SELF_TRADE_PREVENTION: Self-trade prevention canceled the trigger's child orders.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.USER_REQUEST: The user explicitly canceled the trigger, or canceled an order that ended it, alone, with a cancel-all or by the dead-man switch: an attached leg's working exit (with oco set, the parent's other legs end with it), or a level of a ladder that ended with nothing filled.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACTIVATED: A trailing stop's activation condition was satisfied and tracking began, for a standalone or an attached trailing stop.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: An attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop started protecting its parent order's filled quantity, once, when the parent's first fill made it live (or at its resume, when it was paused before that fill). Later fills that resize it, and later pauses and resumes, do not repeat it. An attached trailing stop still reports ACTIVATED when it starts tracking.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger became terminal after its next child order could not be admitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRED: Trigger fired and may have created a child order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FIRE_REFUSED: A fire of the trigger was refused and the trigger stayed live: an attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop waits for the next price through its trigger price, or, refused because its order would be below the market's minimums, waits until its position changes; a trigger refused for a rate limit or an account repair fires again shortly. An attached take-profit, stop-loss or trailing stop whose order self-trade prevention expired against another of the account's resting orders stays live too (SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED), reported once while that order blocks it. New trades and price updates do not fire it while the other order is first in line at the best price; once that order is gone or no longer first there, it fires again if its trigger condition still holds. Not terminal: the trigger keeps its status. child_seq names the refused attempt, which placed no child order, and fire_refusal_reason says why; the next fire takes the next child_seq. With SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED, child_seq names the expired child order instead, which was placed and canceled by self-trade prevention. A ladder level the order book rejected when it arrived (for example POST_ONLY_CROSS) is reported the same way while the ladder keeps working its other levels: child_seq names that level, whose FIRED came first with its child order, now rejected for that reason, and fire_price_ticks is the level's price. A rejected level that was the ladder's last open level ends the ladder instead and has no FIRE_REFUSED, whatever the end: FAILED, naming the first rejected level, when every level was rejected; CANCELED with USER_REQUEST when no level filled and the user canceled a level (directly, by canceling all orders, or by the dead-man switch); otherwise COMPLETED with no event, whether a level filled or the other levels ended unfilled for another reason, such as expiry or self-trade prevention. Read each level's own child order for its rejection.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID: The configured trigger price was invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: The selected trigger price source was not supported.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRIGGER_WOULD_TRIGGER_IMMEDIATELY: The trigger price, or a trailing stop's activation price, was already reached by the price the trigger watches when the trigger was submitted (at or past it), so the trigger would have fired or activated at once. It never armed and sent no order; its reserved funds were released. A price that reaches it after submission fires or activates the trigger normally.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_CAPACITY_REACHED: The market had no room for another TWAP order.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP_INTERVAL_INVALID: The TWAP interval was not valid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNKNOWN_SYMBOL: The requested trading pair was not recognized.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_FIELD_SET: The trigger set a field that must be left unset.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ARMED: Trigger admitted and actively evaluating conditions.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CANCELED: Trigger was canceled. The cancel reason states why, for example a user request or another attached leg's exit closing its parent's position. A ladder is canceled when the ladder itself is canceled. A ladder whose child orders the user canceled with none filled, one by one, with a cancel-all or by the dead man's switch, is canceled too, with a user request reason, once none of them remains open. A ladder whose child orders were canceled only by self-trade prevention, or by the exchange while it recovered the account, with none filled, completes instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.COMPLETED: Trigger completed. A ladder completes once none of its child orders remains open and at least one of them was placed on the book, unless it ends canceled (see CANCELED). A ladder that filled any quantity completes however its other child orders ended. Some of its child orders may have been rejected. Completed does not mean the ladder filled: its executed quantity and executed levels state what filled, and each child order's own status states how it ended.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREATED: Trigger was created and is pending activation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: Trigger failed (for example, reservation failure, child order rejection). A ladder fails when every child order was rejected before it was placed on the book; the failure reason is the first rejected child order's.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PAUSED: Trigger is paused (user-initiated, can be resumed).
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RUNNING: Trigger is actively executing (for example, TWAP slices in progress).

x-poly-enum-descriptions.LADDER: Ladder/Scaled: Multiple orders placed across a price range.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STOP_LOSS: Stop-loss: fires when the price crosses a threshold.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TAKE_PROFIT: Take-profit: fires when the price crosses a threshold.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TRAILING_STOP: Trailing stop: dynamic stop that trails price by a distance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.TWAP: TWAP: Time-Weighted Average Price execution over a duration.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.
